resume: CoralFlower is made for chords: a chord key turns every note you play into a full chord, with a bass note underneath. A pixel flower grows while you play.

commandes.role: On the main screen, records what you play into a new pattern, after a one-bar count-in.
The low keys play the notes of the chosen scale; a high key turns each note into a chord (major, minor, sus2, sus4, 6, 7, add9). Two high keys combine. The Off key turns chords off.

modes.texte: In Top, the upper row chooses the chord type and the lower row the root. In Side, a few keys on the left choose the type and the rest play the roots. Lock mode keeps the chord type you touched without having to hold its key; a new FM-1 starts in Top with Lock.
